name: Soma — Neural Sensation Subscription Network
description: Soma is a premium, subscription-gated neural-feed platform specializing in high-fidelity sensory experiences — not memories or thoughts, but pure physical sensation recordings: the specific proprioceptive pleasure of a perfect athletic movement, the exact sensory texture of a rare meal, the calibrated physiological state of deep meditative calm. Founded in 2215 by neurofeed engineer Cassiel Reyes-Okonkwo and backed by Corponation Neuroplex, Soma occupies the space between wellness platform and sensation marketplace, with its top creators earning more from a single premium sensation-pack than most Tier 3 workers earn in a year. The platform's sophisticated sensation-compression codec, called SomaScript, is proprietary and requires Neuroplex-certified BCI hardware to access at full fidelity.
cultural_impact: Soma has accelerated BCI hardware stratification — the quality of experience available on the platform scales directly with hardware tier, creating a visceral, literal inequality where wealthier users feel better content and poorer users receive degraded sensation feeds. The platform has also generated serious addiction and dissociation concerns, with neurologists in 2223 documenting a condition called Soma Drift — a preference for platform-sourced sensation over real-world experience that affects an estimated 200,000 heavy users.
key_figures: Ifeoma Strand-Bjornsen (top creator, specializes in athletic and flow-state recordings, 8M subscribers)
locations: Soma Studios, Neuroplex Tower sublevel 3, Tier 4
The Sensation Exchange, a Tier 3 licensed access café on Lakeview Corridor
Underground SomaScript cracking dens in Tier 2, where pirated feeds run on uncertified hardware
story_hooks: A Soma sensation-pack goes viral that appears to contain an embedded compulsion signal — users who experience it report an overwhelming urge to purchase a specific Neuroplex hardware upgrade — and the engineer who discovered it has gone quiet.

A Tier 1 hacker collective has cracked SomaScript and is distributing pirated sensation feeds through Residue, but the compressed files contain corrupted sensation data that is causing seizures in users with older BCI hardware.

Cassiel Reyes-Okonkwo approaches a fixer with evidence that Neuroplex has been secretly harvesting raw neural response data from every Soma session — building a complete map of what sensations make people compliant, afraid, or euphoric — and wants help getting out alive.
user_base: 19 million subscribers; primarily Tier 3-4 adults 25-55 with mid-to-high grade BCI hardware; significant piracy user base in Tier 2 estimated at 3-5 million
monetization: Tiered monthly subscriptions (Φ45-Φ280/month depending on hardware fidelity level), creator revenue sharing at 60/40 split favoring Soma, and premium sensation-pack marketplace with individual purchase options
notable_feature: SomaScript codec — a proprietary sensation compression and transmission format that encodes full-body physiological states with enough fidelity that recipients report the experience as indistinguishable from the original, contingent on certified hardware
